EXACT 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 equal SQUARE panels, one tiny drawing operation added per panel, same scale and fixed position in every panel, plain warm ivory paper background. CUMULATIVE stages in reading order; faint previous construction remains until last cleaning panel. NO text, numbers, captions, borders or gutters. Draw detailed confident pencil/ink artwork, NOT schematic stick icons. The panel fills with the specified close-up, not a tiny whole body. Use ONLY the FIRST FRONT duck from reference. Preserve exact original character: cream/pink spiky feather head, TWO tired organic eyes plus cyan round cyber implant ABOVE the viewer-right eye, broad orange bill, mechanical black neck, worn cream tank and dogtag, mechanical forearm/hand on VIEWER LEFT, organic gloved hand VIEWER RIGHT, baggy navy cargo trousers with magenta stripes, worn sneakers. No redesign. CLOSE-UP HEAD only, generously filling each square from crest top to under chin, front view. 12 panels:1 draw just a pale oval skull;2 add only its vertical curved center axis;3 add broad upper bill contour at bottom of oval;4 add lower bill thickness and closed seam as one contour;5 add only viewer-left normal eye;6 add viewer-right normal eye;7 add heavy upper eyelids;8 add outer round cyber-eye ring on forehead ABOVE viewer-right normal eye;9 add cyan glass lens inside this ring;10 add large spiky feather crest tufts at top;11 add cheek feather tufts;12 erase guiding axis and refine complete HEAD ink lineart, orange bill and cream feather color may remain only as faint reference tint. Earlier panels must NOT contain later eye/feather details. Exactly one simple addition each.
